beats.caption: Meenadreen, in the civil parish of Donegal and the barony of Tirhugh. Here is the story of Meenadreen and its fifteen families, from 1873 to 1926.
The parish register of Tawnawilly records two baptisms at Meenadreen between 1873 and 1875. Its marriage entries give no townland, so none are placed here.
The censuses of 1901, 1911 and 1926 counted 65, 62 and 66 people in Meenadreen, in 15, 13 and 15 households. Heads of household included Gillespie, Cassidy and Gildea.
Here are the families of Meenadreen, from 1873 to 1926. First, the Gallagher and Gillespie families.
The Gallagher family appear in the records from 1901 to 1926.

Meenadreen had one Gallagher household in 1911, headed by John.
